question: In a certain code language, 'COMMON' is written as ‘EQOOQP’ and ‘PREP’ is written as ’RTGR’. How will 'MAGNET' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

 
• COMMON
 
 
• 
 
C + 2 → E

 O + 2 → Q

 M + 2 → O

 M + 2 → O

 O + 2 → Q

 N + 2 → P

 
 
• Therefore, code = EQOOQP
 
 
 
• PREP
 
 
• 
 
P + 2 → R

 R + 2 → T

 E + 2 → G

 P + 2 → R

 
 
• Therefore, code = RTGR
 
 
 
• MAGNET
 
 
• 
 
M + 2 → O

 A + 2 → C

 G + 2 → I

 N + 2 → P

 E + 2 → G

 T + 2 → V

 
 
• Therefore, code = **OCIPGV**
 
 

Hence, "option 4" is the correct answer.
